title: Sector Intelligence Object
description: The eight questions every Sector intelligence record MUST answer. Source: SECTOR_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §13.3, where they are stated as ONE PROSE SENTENCE and never enumerated or encoded. This file is the first machine-readable form of that rule. It conforms to AEIT_06's `Knowledge Object` (claim, entity_ref, confidence, trust, freshness, source_id, state) expressed through the existing Notion fields.

_provenance.invents_nothing: Every constraint below already exists in prose somewhere in 01_Sector/. This file changes the REPRESENTATION, not the rule.
_provenance.enforcement: NOT machine-enforced. No validator reads this file today — `arika-runtime` validates agent frontmatter only and cannot see `.claude/skills/`. A skill conforms by following it. Stated plainly so no reader mistakes this schema for a gate.

what.description: Q1 — the claim itself. One finding, not a paragraph of context.

source.description: Q2 — where the claim comes from. A claim with no source is not a finding.

authority.description: The publishing body. The tier test is about the publisher, not the page.

url.description: NULL is the honest default. A URL written from memory is fabrication.

tier.description: INHERITED from the registered source (DB14 Authority Level). A record may never out-rank its publisher.

source_id.description: DB14 Source ID slug. NULL only while the source registry is empty.

notion_field.DB7: Authoritative Source + Source URL + Source Tier + Signal Source

when_observed.description: Q3 — when this was true, and when it was last checked. Freshness is not optional metadata; it is what stops truth decaying into fiction.

next_verification.description: Derived from the proximity escalation ladder — SECTOR_CALENDAR_REFRESH_SPEC.md §2a.

reliability.description: Q4 — how much weight this carries. Confidence MUST match the evidence; weak evidence plus High confidence is a constitutional breach, not a rounding error.

confidence_basis.description: Why this confidence and not the next one up.

content_boundary_mapping._note: Content (04) uses a 5-value vocabulary. The documented mapping covers only 3 of 5 — a known lossy edge (F9).

which_sector.description: Q5 — the market this is true of. Resolved through the Sub-Sector hub, never asserted from free text.

sector_id.description: Resolved via DB2 Parent Sector. Never supplied independently.

geography_id.description: Set ONLY when the claim is true somewhere specific. 'Nairobi MICE demand concentrates Sep-Nov' is a Nairobi fact, not a Hospitality fact.

which_decision.description: Q6 — the decision this supports. THE DECISION-PURPOSE GATE (Contract §13.3): populate a field only when it has a named downstream decision. A datapoint no decision consumes is noise — do not collect it, do not store it.

which_consumer.description: Q7 — which system consumes it. MUST be non-empty. See $defs/department for the vocabulary problem this exposes.

what_action.description: Q8 — what can actually be done. An observation with no available action is not actionable intelligence.

department.description: The canonical department routing vocabulary — resolves finding F2 and OWNER_INPUT_NEEDED item 31a. It is not a Sector-curated subset: it IS the GLOBAL_OS.md §4 department registry, per AEIT_06's rule that 'departments consume canonical entities; they do not reinvent them.' Values and names are taken verbatim from §4 so this enum cannot drift from the registry by paraphrase. Full rationale, per-department route evidence and the Notion migration map: `department-vocabulary.json`.
department._status: DECIDED AND APPLIED 2026-08-24 — repo artifacts and both live Notion option sets. Verified: every pre-existing option ID survived byte-identically; zero rows lost a value.
department._legacy_values_still_live: DB 7 `Departments Affected` also retains two deprecated options — `Revenue (Ops)` (canonical: Operations) and `ClientPartner` (canonical: ClientPartner Acquisition). They are retained because removing an option strips its value from any row using it. A row-level re-tag retires them. Do not write them on new rows.
department._excluded: 18 Cross-Domain Synthesis is deliberately absent — GLOBAL_OS.md §4 records it as NOT an active department (reference archive, no OS file, no owner), so it cannot receive or act on a handoff.
department._note: 19 of the 21 have an evidenced Sector route today. `11 HR / People Ops` and `21 Presence` do not, and are included because the vocabulary is the canonical registry rather than a curated subset — an unused option costs nothing; a missing one costs a route, which is precisely how F2 arose.

examples._comment: Shape only. Values are illustrative and deliberately reference the pilot's real, cited finding rather than inventing one.
examples.what: Effective OTA commission for independent Kenyan properties runs 15-30%, above the headline rate

reliability.confidence_basis: consistent across multiple commercial-intel sources; no T1 publisher confirms the range for Kenya specifically

examples.which_decision: Whether the OTA Leakage & Direct-Booking Audit is a defensible gateway offer for this market
examples.what_action: Route to Offer (02) as the gateway-offer thesis; route to Content (04) as the 'OTA tax' narrative
